build_asr_pipeline: build a python module to create an AutomaticSpeechRecognitionPipeline with a given model ID
run_asr_transcription: run the AutomaticSpeechRecognitionPipeline to transcribe a numpy audio waveform into text
review_encoder_asr_loading: review the AutomaticSpeechRecognitionPipeline to load an EncoderASR model from hparams
refactor_beam_size: refactor the AutomaticSpeechRecognitionPipeline to adjust the decoder beam size for EncoderDecoderASR models
summarize_whisper_asr_init: summarize the AutomaticSpeechRecognitionPipeline initialization for WhisperASR model loading
